title: Checkout degrades minutes after a routine release
root_cause_summary: The nightly reconciliation job was rescheduled into business hours and took a long-held lock on the orders table. The release two minutes before onset was unrelated and touched no database path.

required_evidence.why: the rescheduled batch job, one minute before onset
the blocking query named in the lock wait, which identifies the job directly
lock waits rather than resource saturation

red_herrings.why_tempting: a checkout deploy two minutes before onset, on the service that is failing - the single most tempting wrong answer in the set, and it touches no database path
